paper_title: Knowledge Crosswords Geometric Knowledge Reasoning with Large Language   Models
caption: Problem distribution based on the correctness under the w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge settings using Zero-Shot.
model_annotation: This pie chart displays the distribution of problems based on correctness under "with knowledge" and "without knowledge" settings, utilizing a Zero-Shot approach. The chart is divided into four segments, each representing a different condition, and includes a legend detailing these conditions. The segments are colored teal, gold, and salmon. The teal segment labeled "N+K+" represents approximately 37.3% of the distribution, while the gold segment labeled "N-K+" comprises roughly 38.3%, and the salmon segment labeled "N-K-" accounts for about 37.9%. A smaller gold segment labeled “1.7%” and a smaller salmon segment labeled "4.6%" are also present. Percentage labels are provided directly within each slice, and the segments appear ordered visually by decreasing size.
